scope: Attempt all 27 registered image endpoints, including visible display and the 13 measurement-held routes, in a separate exploratory numerical lane. Do not replace the fixed primary modules or change their 36-test family.
input_boundary: A completed, independently verified partial or full original-stream observation view and its exact saved raw numerical archives; no new image requests. A partial source-ordered checkpoint is explicitly not representative full-cohort ecology.
measurement_view: Use existing per-head endpoint QC, including paired hue and closed-composition support. Retain all raw values and original admission flags. Reconstruct endpoint-matched head size and sharpness from the same QC-eligible heads; never borrow operational quality from another endpoint. This is basic-QC exploration, not promotion of a held route.
aggregation: Equal QC-eligible heads within a photo, then equal distinct decoded images within an observation. Require every request-candidate photo of an included observation to have a terminal record. Reuse the verified view's duplicate-pixel representatives and source dependence identities.
missingness: Each endpoint has its own observation cohort. Require its finite response, matched positive size and nonnegative sharpness, the retained nine environmental predictors and fixed source nuisance fields. No imputation, missing-to-zero conversion, full27 complete-case restriction, taxon cap or trait-dependent predictor selection.
estimator: analysis.v3.module_ecology.fit_matched_module, one response coordinate per endpoint; same joint random-slope working model, nuisance adjustment, equal-taxon among fit and matched among-minus-within contrast. Keep locally sparse taxa. Reject nonidentifiable or unconverged fits without dropping predictors or changing optimization tolerances.
response_transform: Use registered units except square roots of the four closed colour composition fractions. Hue sine/cosine share measurement support and are reported as paired coordinates of one circular quantity. The four fractions are one composition. Endpoint coefficients are descriptive decompositions, not 27 independent biological discoveries.
coefficient_slot_definition: 27 endpoints x 9 retained predictors x 3 scales, including null entries for non-estimable endpoints.
uncertainty: Point-estimate exploration only. No P values, significance flags, confidence intervals or qualified ecological claims. Spatial and image-quality covariates are included, but dependence-calibrated uncertainty and measurement-error propagation are not supplied by this lane. Preserve known source components for subsequent qualified analyses.
primary_boundary: Primary measurement decisions, primary model definitions, live calibration, calibration thresholds and bootstrap draws are unchanged. Looking at this exploration cannot justify promoting a held endpoint, selecting a successful environmental association or retuning either lane.
output: Private exact cohort/quality table, realized-design diagnostics, per-endpoint fit records including failures, all729 coefficient slots, execution identities and aggregate public receipt. Do not publish private rows or treat an uploaded artifact as permanent publication archiving.
